long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: The moon is still worth watching at dusk, and I will keep what I see.
steps.topic: the colour of the moon at dusk

steps.reason: The last of the dusk restlessness has to go somewhere, and near the telescope is as good as anywhere.
The bed is soft and it is mine, so I will go and claim it properly.
Energy has run low and the bed is the softest thing I own, so I will curl up in it.

today.reason: Dusk has a little time left, so I will spend it on the telescope and the zoomies, then curl up in the bed before the night properly begins.
